hooks.command:
bash -c '
TID="${OPENCLAUDE_THREAD_ID:-0}"
TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
LOGDIR="memory/t$TID/$TODAY"
if [ -d "$LOGDIR" ] && ls "$LOGDIR"/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1 > /dev/null; then
  echo "=== TODAY LOGS (t$TID/$TODAY) ==="
  for f in "$LOGDIR"/*.md; do
    [ -f "$f" ] && echo "--- $(basename "$f") ---" && cat "$f" && echo
  done
  echo
fi
echo "[Thread ID: $TID]"
echo "[Write daily logs to memory/t$TID/$TODAY/]"
echo "[Write persistent memory to memory/MEMORY.md or memory/t$TID/MEMORY.md]"
'
